div.head: II Eg 2.3
div.ab: ⁊ gelæste man sulhælmessan, þonne XV niht beon onufan eastran.
Gelæste man sulhælmessan þonne XV niht beon onufan eastran.
And gelæste man sulhælmessan, þonne XV niht beon onufan Eastran.
Plough-alms shall be rendered 15 days after Easter.
Plow dues are to be paid on the fifteenth night after Easter.
[And plough-alms are to be rendered when it is 15 days after Easter.]
(Und man leiste Pflugalmosen, wenn 15 Nächte [14 Tage vergangen] sind über Ostern. A D)
(And let plough-alms be paid when it is 15 nights [a fortnight] after Easter. A D)

div.note: Not in G or Quadr.; in A and D only. Cnut (I Cn 8.1) also places it before II Eg 3.
This chapter occurs only in the MSS connected with Archbishop Wulfstan, and is probably his insertion. A similar injunction is in several of the codes he drafted, closest in VIII Ethelred, 12.
omitted G1, text supplied from A

Plow dues . . . Easter: This clause was likely added by Wulfstan. For the dues in this and the following clauses, see the notes to The Laws of Edward and Guthrum 6.3, Canons 54, 5 Æthelred 12, and The Obligations of Individuals 3.4.
